content.text:
**Finding submitted — deviation (Section 11.1).**

Section 11 partly works in our favour: 11.2 gives 30-day return of Customer Data in a documented, machine-readable format (and bars withholding over fee disputes), and 11.3 gives certified deletion only after we confirm successful return. Those two meet the preferred position on data return and deletion.

Section 11.1, however, is walk-away language — immediate permanent deletion on termination, no export or migration support, and no transition assistance period of any length. It also directly contradicts 11.2/11.3, which is a practical risk that our data is destroyed before export.

Redline (validated, ok:true): 11.1 replaced with up to six months of transition assistance at Vendor's then-current rates, including export/migration/knowledge transfer, and deletion subordinated to Sections 11.2 and 11.3. The comment offers 90 days as our fallback.
